title: Fronts of War Art Asset Catalog
intent: Stable art slots for placeholder-first production. Gameplay remains primitive until an entry is approved.

entries.name: Bocage grass and field ground tile
entries.notes: Approved for terrain-tile integration. Validate edge continuity with adjacent road/ground tiles before use.

entries.name: Sunken muddy lane segment
entries.notes: Approved for route integration. Validate both ends against adjacent route and shoulder tiles before use.

entries.name: Sculpted hedgerow wall segment
entries.notes: Approved for map-edge/hedgerow integration. Validate joins and route clearance before use.

entries.name: Norman-style stone farmhouse
entries.notes: Approved for Western Europe map integration. Keep as a hero/location asset and validate footprint clearance.

entries.name: Farmyard supply prop cluster
entries.notes: Approved for Western Europe environmental storytelling and supply-cluster integration.

entries.name: Mediterranean rocky wadi ground tile
entries.notes: Approved for Mediterranean terrain-tile integration. Validate edge continuity with adjacent road/ground tiles before use.

entries.name: Eastern Europe snowbound road tile
entries.notes: Approved for Eastern Europe terrain-tile integration. Validate edge continuity with adjacent road/ground tiles before use.

entries.name: Pacific jungle mud-track tile
entries.notes: Approved for Pacific route-tile integration. Validate both ends against adjacent route and shoulder tiles before use.

entries.name: Pacific jungle foliage cluster
entries.notes: Approved for Pacific vegetation integration. Preserve route readability and avoid infantry-like silhouettes at gameplay scale.

entries.name: Commander's painted map-table frame
entries.notes: Approved for command-table presentation UI such as menu, briefing, or mission select. Validate layout and safe center space before integration.

entries.name: Western Europe sunken lane - straight north/south
entries.notes: Generated route-family candidate. Outer socket bands are normalized; requires same-theater seam and gameplay-readability review.

entries.name: Western Europe sunken lane - straight east/west
entries.notes: Generated route-family candidate. Derived from WE-ROUTE-001 for exact rotational consistency.

entries.name: Western Europe sunken lane - corner north/east
entries.notes: Generated color route-family corner anchor and canonical edge-socket source.

entries.name: Western Europe sunken lane - corner east/south
entries.notes: Generated route-family candidate. Derived from WE-ROUTE-003 for exact rotational consistency.

entries.name: Western Europe sunken lane - corner south/west
entries.notes: Generated route-family candidate. Derived from WE-ROUTE-003 for exact rotational consistency.

entries.name: Western Europe sunken lane - corner west/north
entries.notes: Generated route-family candidate. Derived from WE-ROUTE-003 for exact rotational consistency.

entries.name: Western Europe sunken lane - T north/east/south
entries.notes: Generated color route-family T-junction candidate with normalized edge sockets.

entries.name: Western Europe sunken lane - T east/south/west
entries.notes: Generated route-family candidate. Derived from WE-ROUTE-007 for exact rotational consistency.

entries.name: Western Europe sunken lane - four-way cross
entries.notes: Generated color route-family crossroads candidate with normalized edge sockets.

entries.name: Western Europe sunken lane - north entry/dead-end
entries.notes: Generated color route-family entry/dead-end candidate with one normalized north socket.

entries.name: Western Europe shared sunken-lane route material
entries.notes: Review-only transparent shared material for the layered route proof; fixed 256 px road core plus 48 px shoulders per side.

entries.name: Western Europe unique sunken-lane north/east corner overlay
entries.notes: First D45 topology-specific painterly overlay. Transparent route and shoulder with centered North/East sockets; review before expanding the family.

entries.name: Western Europe unique sunken-lane west/north corner overlay
entries.notes: D45 transparent topology overlay with centered West/North sockets; review-only until the family passes mixed-neighbor inspection.

entries.name: Western Europe unique sunken-lane east/south corner overlay
entries.notes: D45 transparent topology overlay with centered East/South sockets; review-only until the family passes mixed-neighbor inspection.

entries.name: Western Europe unique sunken-lane south/west corner overlay
entries.notes: D45 transparent topology overlay with centered South/West sockets; review-only until the family passes mixed-neighbor inspection.

entries.name: Western Europe unique sunken-lane north/east/south T-junction overlay
entries.notes: D45 transparent topology overlay with one coherent asymmetric T-junction and no West socket.

entries.name: Western Europe unique sunken-lane east/south/west T-junction overlay
entries.notes: D45 transparent topology overlay with one coherent asymmetric T-junction and no North socket.

entries.name: Western Europe unique sunken-lane four-way cross overlay
entries.notes: D45 transparent topology overlay with a single coherent four-way crossroads and four centered sockets.

entries.name: Western Europe unique sunken-lane north entry overlay
entries.notes: D45 transparent topology overlay with one centered North socket and a rounded interior turnaround.

entries.name: Build-pad base family
entries.notes: State changes must use shape/iconography plus color. Empty pads must not resemble finished towers.

entries.name: Build-pad overlays
entries.notes: Overlays stay readable over all theater palettes and never obscure routes.

entries.name: Route markers
entries.notes: Authoring/readability markers; avoid decorative clutter during combat.

entries.name: Theater transition pieces
entries.notes: Keep route edges natural but geometrically unambiguous.

entries.name: Shared obstruction and damage overlays
entries.notes: Non-graphic environmental storytelling only; decals must not compete with units or routes.

entries.name: Commander map-table frame
entries.notes: The existing generated image is review-only. Keep the battlefield center neutral and unobscured.

entries.name: Mission paperwork and neutral markers
entries.notes: No real political or extremist symbols.

entries.name: Armor, damage, status, and air glyph family
entries.notes: Shape must carry meaning in grayscale and at native gameplay size.

entries.name: Weather and lighting overlays
entries.notes: Weather never obscures enemy silhouettes, build pads, routes, range indicators, or status icons.

entries.name: Western Europe terrain kit
entries.notes: Existing review assets remain separate entries below.

entries.name: Western Europe terrain and story decals
Eastern Europe authored clusters and decals
Shared destruction states
entries.notes: No civilians, corpses, gore, or graphic aftermath.

entries.name: Shared non-graphic combat VFX
entries.notes: Must support Full, Reduced, and Minimal effects settings.

entries.name: Art validation and reference sheets
entries.notes: Authoring references, not runtime art.

entries.name: Held national tower and signature visuals
entries.notes: Structured only. Do not generate or integrate until the implementation review clears nation and enemy identity art.

entries.name: Held friendly and national unit art
entries.notes: Held per the user's review request.

entries.name: Held enemy archetype skins and wrecks
entries.notes: Held until implementation and silhouette review.
